description: [Data utilities] Check a medicine's official US label warnings, recalls and most-reported adverse reactions. Use when an agent needs citable FDA facts about a drug. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/drug-safety

drug.description: Brand or generic drug name, e.g. Advil or ibuprofen

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: drug_safety
title: Drug Label, Recall & Adverse Event Check (openFDA) ($0.003)
